description:
Send text and get its sha256 or keccak256 hash as hex. Listed by Moonbeam: nine outside sellers stand behind it, and the best-ranked one answers.

The answer is checked before you pay, so a failed answer is not charged, and it is graded after. One call is 0.0012 USDC, paid with x402 on Base.. 0.0012 USDC a call, paid with x402 on Base: without a payment the call answers the payment terms; send the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (or as `payment`, the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value) and call again.

payment.description: optional: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for the terms the first call answered

name: mcp_digest
title: text digest (sha256, keccak256)
